row.headline: TikTok’s $980 mln HCM City logistics project secures investment certificate
row.summary: TikTok's logistics project in HCM City has secured an investment certificate with a total registered capital of VNĐ25.85 trillion (US$980 million), including $196 million in contributed capital.
